learning_outcomes.text: The student can compare and evaluate 3 cross-platform techniques using a test case.
The student can interpret and (correctly) apply the documentation of the framework/development environment.
The student can communicate about their test case with the correct terminology and depth.

assessment_methods.method: Oral defense of test case and comparative study (Lab)

assessment_rules: The final grade is based on two components: Cross Development Theory and Cross Development Lab. The Theory component is assessed via a written test (100%). The Lab component is assessed via an oral defense of a test case implemented on 3 different frameworks with a comparative study (100%). Partial results are transferable within the academic year if successful.
